gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the four shipped node -e read-backs dereference the parsed value outside their try/catch, so a well-formed file holding literal `null` throws an uncaught TypeError rather than printing the promised scratch-shape refusal
gaps.evidence: Executed the shipped triage-gate.md read-back verbatim against a file containing `null`: uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of null (reading outcomes)', no named reason on stderr. Same dereference at cadence-core/workflows/progress.md:101 (r[k]), cadence-core/workflows/report.md compose read-back (r.brackets), cadence-core/references/triage-gate.md:84 (r.outcomes). PLAN-2 'Must be true when done' requires a named reason for a well-formed file of the wrong shape; scratch-readback.test.mjs has no null fixture, so nothing holds this.
gaps.missing: Guard the parsed value before dereferencing it at all four sites (refuse as scratch-shape when the parse result is not a non-null object), and add a null fixture row to cadence-core/bin/scratch-readback.test.mjs so the arm is pinned.
